section.title: Introduction
section.para: This class implements a HomePlug AV message header encoder/decoder. When instantiated, it provides access the Ethernet header plus the HomePlug AV version and message type field. Class methods may be used to encode/decode or import/export a complete header or individual header fields stored in external memory in proper byte order.

Encode and export methods write class properties to external memory in network byte order. Decode and import methods read class properties from external memory in network byte order. Encode and decode methods always return the next unencoded or undecoded memory byte. Import and Export methods always return the object instance reference allowing class methods to be chained.
The MessageType property and SetMessageType method perform implicit integer host-to-little-endian and little-endian-to-host conversion.
This class is declared in ohomeplug.hpp and defined in ohomeplug.cpp.

section.title: Inheritance
section.para: This class inherits the oethernet class to implement the ethernet header portion of the message.

section.title: Dependence
section.para: This class references static class omemory to manipulate memory.

section.title: Properties
section.para: Class properties include all oethernet properties plus those described below.

section.title: ohomeplug::HeaderLength
section.para: Return HomePlug AV header length in bytes. The header length includes the Ethernet HeaderLength plus the HomePlug MessageVersion and MessageType lengths. Use this property to allocate buffer space in application programs.

section.title: ohomeplug::MessageType
section.para: Return the HomePlug AV message type as an integer in host byte order. This property is the same as the MMTYPE field described in the HomePlug AV Specification. On instantiation, this property contains oHOMEPLUG_MMTYPE, as defined in ohomeplug.hpp.

section.title: ohomeplug::MessageTypeString
section.para: Return the HomePlug AV message type as a string. The string is 6 characters long including the NUL terminator.

section.title: ohomeplug::MessageVersion
section.para: Return the HomePlug AV message version as an integer. The message version indicates the revision of the HomePlug AV Specification that describes the message format. On instantiation, this property contains oHOMEPLUG_MMV, as defined in header file ohomeplug.hpp.

section.title: Methods
section.para: Class methods include all oethernet methods plus those described below.

section.title: ohomeplug::ImportHeader
section.para: Decode external memory containing an Ethernet header and HomePlug AV specific header. Return the address of the next undecoded memory byte. Header fields are unpacked and stored in their respective properties. External memory is not changed by this operation. The number of bytes decoded will equal the HeaderLength property. Consequently, the memory address returned will be incremented by that amount and may be used for subsequent decoding operations.

section.title: ohomeplug::ExportHeader
section.para: Encode external memory with a complete HomePlug AV header. Return the address of the next unencoded byte. The encoded memory will contain the Ethernet header plus the HomePlug AV specific MessageVersion and MessageType. Instance property values are not changed by the operation. The number of bytes encoded will equal the HeaderLength property. Consequently, the memory address returned will incremented by that amount and may be used for subsequent encoding operations.

section.title: ohomeplug::SetMessageVersion
section.para: Assign a new value to the message version.

section.title: ohomeplug::SetMessageType
section.para: Specify the HomePlug AV message type as an integer in host byte order. The message type is stored internally in little-endian order. Valid HomePlug AV message types are 0x0000 through 0x9FFC but this method does not validate the argument so any 16-bit value is permitted.

section.title: ohomeplug::Print
section.para: Print the HomePlug AV header on stdout in human-friendly format.
